conclusion: The Delsarte LP for kissing numbers has no headroom in its degree: sweeping degree 1-30 in dimensions 3-24, the value stops moving by degree 14 at the latest, and the sweep rediscovers the published degrees 6 and 10 for E8 and Leech on its own. The binding free parameter is instead the node set used to discretise the semi-infinite sign condition, and that discretisation is a relaxation whose optimum sat strictly below the true kissing number at every node count tested, up to 20000 nodes in dimension 24 and 40000 in dimension 8.
confidence: Lean on the reproduction and the soundness finding; be careful with the ceiling table's fourth decimal. The two exact certificates were rebuilt from contact structure and reproduce 240 and 196560 to 4e-14 and 1.7e-11 relative, which is a real check against a value that is a theorem elsewhere; five planted faults fire, including one that breaks only the coefficient sign condition and is invisible to the interval scan. The soundness finding is a directly checkable number (196505.76 at 600 nodes for a quantity that is exactly 196560). Everything is float grade, no ball arithmetic anywhere, so each row of the ceiling table is a bracket rather than a bound, and the n=3 saturation degree of 27 may be the 1e-6 tolerance chasing noise.

core_candidates.what: a semi-infinite-LP repair instrument: given a polynomial certificate solved on a finite node set, verify the sign condition off that node set and return the repaired value (f(1) - M)/(f_0 - M) plus the bracket [node optimum, repaired value]
core_candidates.why_reusable: every semi-infinite programme this lab has touched or will touch (Delsarte LP, Cohn-Elkies, Bachoc-Vallentin, Weil-positivity probes in zeta/weil.py) is solved by discretising a continuum of constraints, and the discretisation is always a relaxation in the same direction. The instrument turns 'the grid may have been too coarse' from a fatal objection into an explicit price, and it is subject-agnostic: it takes a basis-evaluation callable and an interval, nothing else.
